motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: Ugh... Treating a girl like this is just unacceptable!

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: I'll be back! A Heisei girl doesn't give up so easily!

motions.name: broken_3
motions.line: Will they help me fix my uniform too? I don't want to have to keep coming back here.

motions.name: broken_4
motions.line: Hm? I feel like I could go for another bowl of rice.

motions.name: broken_5
motions.line: Wait a minute, Commander! Give a girl some time to get ready!

motions.name: login
motions.line: Good morning, Commander! Let's get started already.

motions.name: login
motions.line: Good morning, Commander! Let's get started already.

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: Huh? We have to queue for an hour if we can't go through the VIP entrance? Fine. Give me your ID number, Commander. I think we'd better get VIP tickets for the theme park.

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: My, what are you looking at? Look up - up! Hehe, twintails really are the best, don't you think?

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: Ah, do you finally understand the logic behind it, Commander? Instead of wasting your own effort, you should buy a ready-made Christmas feast. With time that you saved... Want to guess which one of these Christmas presents is from me?

motions.name: touch_4
motions.line: Hehe, what do you think about my new invention? It's a roomba that can do the laundry and cook porridge at the same time! Uh, I'll just leave it here with you for now. Don't let 64 Shiki see it or she's gonna faint again.

motions.name: touch_5
motions.line: Don't worry, Commander, it'll be fine! I'll be off, then!

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: Look, Commander! This is my new... Whoa! <>Don't think you can beat me with this thing! I-I'll make even more novel trinkets... <>Gosh, what am I talking about...? Commander, please put it on for me! Right now, I've got nothing to say other than "I do"...

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: Is-is this...rice?! G-gosh, it isn't even an anniversary or anything, so why are you giving me something so valuable...? I-I'm gonna enshrine it! Huh? I'm not crying just because I see rice! These days when I can share my meals with you are much more precious than rice itself...
